# Hardening Validation

A hardening review should verify:

1. Administrative services
2. Administrative users
3. Host-inbound services
4. Security zones
5. Security policies
6. NAT exposure
7. Routing protocol exposure
8. SNMP
9. Logging
10. NTP
11. Software version
12. Configuration backup
13. Rescue configuration
14. Console access
15. Public services

---
